title: Mobile and Portable Command and Control
subtitle: A ten-year programme of specialist command vehicles and rapid-deployment kits on one IP network for live audio, video and data
headline: Mobile and portable command centres on one IP network, delivered across the full life cycle and supported by SciFlair since 2016
photoAlt: Converted command-and-control truck with slide-out operations room
sciflairRole: SciFlair took over service and support from 2016, developed SVMS over the same period, and in 2019 proposed a Phase 2 upgrade that was approved but did not proceed after COVID-19
need: The client needed to collect, monitor and record audio, video and data from many sources in the field, and share it in real time with a central headquarters.
The same capability had to work from a convoy of specialist vehicles and from rugged portable cases that can be set up anywhere, bringing separate systems under one common platform.
role: XAD Communications was the prime contractor and design authority across the whole life cycle, from concept to final retirement. The Technical Director who later founded SciFlair led the programme, directing XAD's audio, video, data and RF engineering groups.
built: A convoy of eight specialist vehicles, each converted for a different operational role
A portable equivalent built into rugged Pelican cases
35 rapidly deployable camera and communication kits, including cameras on pneumatic masts
Vehicle conversions from vans to heavy trucks, with operator workstations, on-board power, air-conditioning and networking
An end-to-end IP network across wired and wireless links, carrying live and recorded audio, video and data
XAD's XVMS video management software, later succeeded by SciFlair's SVMS
builtScope: Eight specialist vehicles, a portable equivalent in Pelican cases and 35 deployable kits, all on one IP network.

delivery.title: Concept and requirements
delivery.text: Operational needs captured and turned into the technical proposals and system requirements.

delivery.title: Architecture and design
delivery.text: One IP architecture so every vehicle, station and kit can work alone or as part of the wider deployment.

delivery.title: Production and verification
delivery.text: Vehicle conversions and portable systems manufactured and integrated, with factory acceptance testing.

delivery.title: Validation and deployment
delivery.text: Site acceptance and field testing in operational conditions, where the system exceeded the client's expectations.

delivery.title: Support and retirement
delivery.text: In-service support for a decade, with SciFlair taking over from 2016, until the programme closed in 2019.

results.label: specialist vehicles in the mobile team

nextGen.title: What came next
nextGen.text: The programme's lessons shaped SciFlair's SVMS video management software, rewritten from the ground up from 2016.
